# semiautoReg

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of `semiautoReg` is to provide a simple workflow for semiparametric regression with autocorrelated errors.

This package combines spline-based flexible regression and autocorrelation correction in one R package structure. It is developed as part of the Statistical Programming course.

## Installation

This package is currently under development.

After the package is uploaded to GitHub, it can be installed using:

```r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("nkhnurkholifah-maker/semiautoReg")
```

## Example

The main functions of this package will be added in the next development stage.

```{r example, eval=FALSE}
library(semiautoReg)
```
